title: An Invalid Winning Trade
hook: It paid. It was still wrong.

launchpad.outcome: Spot an entry that broke the model, watch it win anyway, and refuse to learn the wrong lesson from it.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Can a winner be a warning?

slides.headline: It paid. It was still wrong.
slides.line: A trader took this short and made +2R. Somewhere in here, they broke a rule.
slides.do: Tap the candle where the trader broke a rule. The pink tag shows where they got in.
slides.wrong: Not that one. Look at where they got in, and what hadn’t closed yet.
slides.right: That’s it. They shorted the Correction candle, before the Continuation closed back below the PIL. The right entry was the retest.

slides.headline: So how do you grade it?

options.label: A
options.sub: It won, so it was good
options.say: The result can’t upgrade the process. What rule did the entry break?

options.label: C · rule break
options.sub: It broke the entry rule, even though it won
options.say: Right. Grade the process. Record the +2R separately.

options.label: Don’t grade it
options.say: Ungraded wins become habits. Grade it.

slides.headline: What would repeating this entry teach you?

options.label: Early entries can work, so I can use them sometimes
options.say: That’s the wrong lesson the win is offering. One paid violation turns into a habit.

options.label: That I can break the model and get paid, which is the dangerous part
options.say: Exactly. The win is the warning.

slides.headline: A winner you don’t want to repeat.
slides.dayli: Profitable rule-breaking isn’t evidence. It’s a warning.

takeaways: Store the outcome and the process separately.
remember: A winner can still be a warning.
